blind.description: A traditional wooden dining chair featuring an ornate carved backrest with a central decorative splat and curved top rail. It has four sturdy legs connected by cross-stretchers, with turned front legs ending in gold/brass-capped feet, and slightly curved rear legs. The seat is padded and upholstered in olive green leather or fabric, lined around the base with brass studs/tacks. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled without floating or melted elements.
blind.from_above: A square olive-green cushioned seat attached to a wooden backrest frame that extends slightly backwards, casting a shadow of the chair's backrest to the top-left.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.2 ft tall (reaching roughly half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure, with the seat around 1.5 ft high) and approximately 1.5 ft wide.
